checks.name: Twelve real services and private PostgreSQL ownership
Measured workload, actual container scaling and Kafka telemetry
Service registration, fresh metric events and incident lifecycle
Asynchronous local SMTP delivery and duplicate suppression
Real S3 bytes, encryption, versions and retention
Cost arithmetic and explicit forecast/maintenance limits
Automatic scaling observes demand, bounds and cooldown
Worker failure is detected and a new healthy container replaces it
Kafka outage retains events and consumer restart avoids duplicate incidents
Unavailable dependency returns 503 and recovers without fabricated data
Failed-event quarantine and successful replay after repairing the cause
Notification retries remain independent of metric collection
Encrypted backup, PostgreSQL restore verification and real recovery
MFA enrollment revokes old sessions and blocks unverified privilege
Final service readiness, audit persistence and API specification
